description: Hold out against a strong chess engine that you will rarely beat. The score is mostly the result, then how long the game lasts and how much material you keep, so avoid blunders and trade carefully. Each label is a policy the board turns into a move: CAPTURE takes the best capture, SAVE moves a hanging piece to safety, CASTLE castles, DEVELOP brings a knight or bishop off the back rank, ADVANCE pushes a pawn, PROMOTE pushes the passed pawn nearest queening, CHECK gives check, QUIET plays a safe quiet move. The label is your policy for this move.
